title: signing_key.rotated (v2)
description: The realm's token signing key was rotated. Emitted when a token signing key rotation starts. Planned rotation (administration API or the scheduled worker) creates a new key in the "pending" state that is published in JWKS ahead of use and activated later by the worker without a further event. Emergency rotation activates the new key immediately and marks the previous active key compromised: it is removed from JWKS and its tokens are rejected, so relying parties should refresh JWKS and drop any cached trust in previous_kid. org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. Both payload forms carry every listed member (new_kid, previous_kid and previous_key_compromised are kept in the minimal form).

new_kid.description: Key ID (JWK "kid") of the new key, formatted "<algorithm in lower case>-<YYYYMMDD>-<16 hex digits>".

previous_kid.description: Key ID of the key that was active when the rotation started; empty string when there was none.

previous_key_compromised.description: true for emergency rotations (the previous key is compromised and no longer trusted), false for planned rotations.

organization_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
